title: Save your money
text:
Took my dog a few minutes to shred the two squeeky toys inside.
The treats have to be some of the worst smelling things I've ever had come out of a bag - cod and alligator, really?
Dog ate 'em but the cat ran away. I guess the dog thought anything that smelled good enough to roll in was edible.
The box was packed with stupid prints full of sophomoric humor. I really hope there aren't folks that think that stuff is actually funny. If so they're the kind you hope don't vote.
So two stars only because the dog did eat the treats and the stuffed toy gave him like 5 minutes of destructive fun.
label: negative
